title: The Royal Carpenter Rod Optimizer
statement:
A royal carpenter possesses a long timber rod of length N inches. A trade catalog specifies the selling price P_i for a rod of length i inches (for 1 <= i <= N).

The carpenter can cut the rod into any number of integer-length pieces. Determine the maximum revenue obtainable by cutting up the rod and selling the pieces.
inputFormat:
First line: Integer N.
Second line: N space-separated integers where the i-th integer is the price P_i of a rod of length i.
outputFormat: Print the maximum obtainable total price.

sampleCases.explanation: Cut into two pieces of lengths 2 and 6 for price 5 + 17 = 22.
Cut into two pieces of length 2 each for 5 + 5 = 10.
